items.title: The day the sky emptied: rendering the FAA outage with ClickHouse FORMAT PNG
items.summary: Visualize the November 13 FAA outage using ADS-B flight data and ClickHouse’s FORMAT PNG, rendering an entire day of US air traffic directly from SQL.

items.title: More load is faster: tuning Postgres read replicas
items.summary: Testing Postgres read replicas reveals why more write traffic can reduce lag, how WAL settings affect latency, and where aggressive tuning introduces tradeoffs.
